why: No major reviewer or authority appears. Every answering source is a niche comparison site or affiliate listicle, and they all converge on the UGREEN DXP4800 Plus at $620-$633 without showing the price-ordered field of 10GbE + Quick Sync 4-bays or any testing. Starry Hope holds four slots with one domain, datacenterdisk tracks prices but ignores the 10GbE constraint, and the rest are stale, generic, or off-target. A focused page listing every 4-bay 10GbE Intel-iGPU NAS by current price, with add-a-card alternatives costed out and a direct cheapest pick, would stand out.
